message.reasoning_content:
The main suspicion: float32 Horner accumulation error may exceed 2e-4 relative L2. Also coefficients[:,0] rounding: coefficients[:,0] magnitude ~ sum |coeff|*anchor^k ≈ ~ maybe hundreds; stored float32 rounding of coeff[0] (~1e-5 absolute) enters both kernel and reference equally (reference uses stored value too), so that's fine. The key claim: accumulated float32 rounding error.

Record one in-scope claim.
